out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DR STACKED UR. OBSERVED DIGITAL THERMOMETER ON UNIT READING 37F, BUT INTERIOR OF UNIT WAS NOT COLD ~50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLACE WORK ORDER TO REPLACE UNIT. DO NOT STORE ANY TCS FOODS IN UNIT.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed prepared portioned beef at 49F in ice bath with ice only touching bottom of container.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Employee moved beef to WIC for cold holding. EHS discussed proper arrangement of container in ice bath to facilitate maximum cold transfer to food in container.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Cooling, Heating, Holding Equipment Sufficient
violations.observation: Observed 2 - 2door stacked refrigeration units at cook line out of service.
violations.corrective_action: CFM has work orders placed for repair of units. Observed establishment using ice baths to keep portioned foods cold in one of the units, but EHS recommended to move foods into WIC instead to ensure cold holding temperatures are maintained. CFM will provide proof of repair when completed. IHOP #3117 (Inspection Date: 07/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: ice machine. Observed top cover of ice machine not installed and ice making mechanism exposed. CFM stated work order has been placed due to machine freezing when cover installed.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM had employee place top cover back on machine. CFM recommended to call for service to repair machine.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that ceiling in dry storage hallway/room is leaking water.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM stated due to recent weather, ceiling has been leaking onto floor in dry storage hallway. CFM has requested for immediate repair. CFM will move any items away from leak to prevent contamination. CFM will provide proof of repair to EHS when completed.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sliced cheese (48f), hollandaise sauce (54f), and cheesecake (46f) in the top rail of the 2DR prep unit; and garlic butter (63f) in the 2DR UPR unit at the end of the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT FOOD NEEDS TO BE HELD AT 41f OR LOWER. CONTAINERS IN THE PREP TOP SHOULD ONLY BE FILLED TO THE FILL LINE TO ENSURE PROPER COLD HOLDING. PIC DISCARDED THE GARLIC BUTTER, SAUSAGE, AND HASHBROWNS FROM THE DOWN UNIT.
